questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "price‑hike themes" mean?
questions.explain_en: It refers to topics or trends where companies are increasing the prices of their products.
questions.explain_zh: 指的是公司提高產品價格的趨勢或主題。
questions.news_title_en: Taiwan stocks seen returning to profit-driven gains in Q4 as capital rotates

questions.question: According to the summary, why are passive‑component names attracting funds?
options: Because AI servers and HPC are boosting demand for high‑end MLCCs and chip resistors
Because they have the highest dividend yields
Because they are the largest companies in Taiwan
Because they are unaffected by US rate policy
questions.explain_en: The summary says AI servers and high‑performance computing raise demand for those components, making them attractive.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要指出 AI 伺服器與高效能運算提升了高階 MLCC 與晶片電阻的需求，因而吸引資金。
questions.news_title_en: Taiwan stocks seen returning to profit-driven gains in Q4 as capital rotates

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "probe" mean?
questions.explain_en: Here "probe" refers to an official investigation into possible patent infringement.
questions.explain_zh: 這裡的「probe」指的是對可能的專利侵權進行的官方調查。
questions.news_title_en: Foxconn and Taiwan peers named in US ITC Section 337 patent probe

questions.question: According to the summary, what did Foxconn say about its operations after the USITC investigation started?
options: They were moved to another country
questions.explain_en: Foxconn stated that its operations remain normal, with no material impact on production, shipments, or customer cooperation.
questions.explain_zh: 富士康表示其營運仍然正常，對產量、出貨或客戶合作沒有實質影響。
questions.news_title_en: Foxconn and Taiwan peers named in US ITC Section 337 patent probe

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "havens" mean?
options: Places where investors keep money safe
questions.explain_en: Here "havens" refers to safe investment options where investors put cash to protect it from market risk.
questions.explain_zh: 此處的「havens」指的是投資人為了避險而把資金放入的安全投資工具。
questions.news_title_en: Money-market funds pull in $153.8bn as investors flee to safety

questions.question: How much net inflow did global money‑market funds receive in the week to Oct 7?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that global money‑market funds took in $153.81 bn in that week.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明全球貨幣市場基金在該週淨流入 153.81 億美元。
questions.news_title_en: Money-market funds pull in $153.8bn as investors flee to safety

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "retreated" mean?
questions.explain_en: The market "retreated" after reaching highs, meaning it fell back down.
questions.explain_zh: 文中「retreated」指的是在創高之後回落，意思是跌回去。
questions.news_title_en: Twelve Taiwan equity ETFs hit record size even as the index pulls back

questions.question: Which ETF had the highest total‑return gain this year according to the summary?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that 00927 leads with a 107.36% gain, the highest among the listed ETFs.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要說 00927 的總報酬率為 107.36%，是最高的。
questions.news_title_en: Twelve Taiwan equity ETFs hit record size even as the index pulls back

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "impasse" mean?
options: A complete stop with no progress
questions.explain_en: "Impasse" means a situation where no further progress can be made.
questions.news_title_en: Qualcomm–Arm licensing fight stalls again as jury fails to reach a verdict

questions.question: When is the trial scheduled to resume?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the trial resumes on Tuesday, Oct 13.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說審判將於 10 月 13 日（星期二）恢復。
questions.news_title_en: Qualcomm–Arm licensing fight stalls again as jury fails to reach a verdict

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "headline" mean when it says "headline CPI"?
options: The main or overall CPI figure
A CPI that only includes food prices
The title of a newspaper article
questions.explain_en: "Headline CPI" refers to the overall consumer price index, the main figure that shows total inflation.
questions.explain_zh: 「headline CPI」指的是整體消費者物價指數，是顯示總體通膨的主要數值。
questions.news_title_en: US September CPI and the Fed meeting headline a pivotal week

questions.question: According to the summary, when is the Federal Reserve expected to make its next policy decision?
questions.explain_en: The text says the Fed's decision is scheduled for late October, after the September CPI data.
questions.explain_zh: 文中指出美聯儲的下一次政策決策將在十月下旬，於九月 CPI 資料之後。
questions.news_title_en: US September CPI and the Fed meeting headline a pivotal week
